subject: Crystal Simulation, protein broken across unit cell

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber community,
How can I simulate a crystal lattice of a protein where the protein does not fit within the unit cell? That is, there would need to be covalent bonds across the simulation box boundary, which doesn’t make sense to me. I’d appreciate any advice/suggestions to deal with this situation?
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Steinbrecher, Thomas
messages.body:
Hi Matthew,
I dont think Amber supports covalent bonds across the PBC box edges.
Couldnt you simulate a supercell, say 2x2x2 crystal unit cells, that allows
your complete protein to fit into one simulation box?
Kind Regards,
Thomas
